title: Rejected candidate or migrated record (<stem>.errors.jsonl / <stem>.migrated.errors.jsonl, one object per line)

stage.description: candidate: malformed/duplicate candidate; evidence: quote/page verification; validation: assembled record fails the contract; dataset: dataset-level rule; migration: a record produced by `bdc migrate` fails the contract

candidate_index.description: Index into candidates.json; absent for system records

candidate.description: The (repaired) candidate as the backend produced it

record.description: The assembled record that failed validation

source_path.description: migration: location of the item in the legacy document (e.g. relations[1])

input_line.description: migration: line of the source JSONL

instance.description: migration: instance number in the omics source file

conflicts.description: migration: source leaves that competed for the same target field
